store.3: I make sure they have everything they need. Helping them transition into retirement without financial stress is one of my proudest achievements—it's a reminder that wealth is most meaningful when it provides security for the people you love.

store.21: I have a long-term approach to managing my personal portfolio, balancing high-risk opportunities with stable, income-generating investments. Equities and private equity make up the core, but I also hold a mix of bonds, real estate, and alternative assets. I don't chase trends - I look for asymmetric upside. If an opportunity doesn't have a significant margin of safety or a compelling growth narrative, it doesn't make it into my portfolio. My goal is not just wealth accumulation, but also capital preservation and strategic growth.

store.42: I have known Sarah Chen, CEO of Pacific Dynamics, for over 15 years. We first met at a Goldman conference in 2008, but our real connection happened six months later on a delayed flight from Hong Kong. We spent five hours talking about market trends and our shared love of jazz, which formed a strong foundation for our relationship. Now, she's not just a business contact, but someone I can call at 3 AM for a straight answer about Asian markets. This kind of network makes a difference in this industry.
